error.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: Your account is suspended. Contact an admin.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access here.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request differs from the previous one.

error.CLAIM_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Daily claim limit reached. Try tomorrow.

MATCH_SUGGESTED.title: A possible match
MATCH_SUGGESTED.body: We found a report similar to "{reportTitle}".

MATCH_INVITE.title: Someone may have found your item
MATCH_INVITE.body: A finder thinks this might be yours: "{foundTitle}".

CLAIM_SUBMITTED.title: Someone claimed your found item
CLAIM_SUBMITTED.body: Someone answered your verification questions for "{reportTitle}".

CLAIM_APPROVED.title: Your claim was approved 🎉
CLAIM_APPROVED.body: The finder approved your claim. Arrange the handover in the claim room.

CLAIM_REJECTED.title: Your claim was not approved
CLAIM_REJECTED.body: Reason: {reason}. You can open a dispute if this seems wrong.

CLAIM_REMINDER.title: Do not forget to review the claim
CLAIM_REMINDER.body: The claim for "{reportTitle}" awaits your decision. It expires in 24 hours.

MESSAGE_RECEIVED.title: New message from {senderName}
MESSAGE_RECEIVED.body: Open the claim room to reply.

HANDOVER_CONFIRMED.title: Handover confirmed
HANDOVER_CONFIRMED.body: One side confirmed. Your confirmation is needed.

REPORT_RETURNED.title: The item is back!
REPORT_RETURNED.body: The claim is complete and the item was handed over. Thank you for being honest.

REPORT_EXPIRED.title: Your report has expired
REPORT_EXPIRED.body: You can still renew within 30 days.

REPORT_REMOVED.title: Your report was removed by a moderator
REPORT_REMOVED.body: Reason: {reason}. Contact an admin if this seems wrong.

ADMIN_DISPUTE.title: A new dispute needs review
ADMIN_DISPUTE.body: Claim {claimShortId} was disputed. Open the queue to review.
